title: ConformanceCases
description: Catalogue of conformance cases. Each case checks one observable behaviour of the contract or of an adapter; cases that need a broker, a real adapter or a real harness are listed and reported as skipped with their reason.

schema_version.description: Contract version of the catalogue. Must be 1.

id.description: Unique identifier in upper kebab case.

title.description: What the case verifies, in one sentence.

level.description: contract runs against the simulated child and the reference model; harness runs against a real harness.

requires.description: What the case needs to run: none, a running broker, or a real adapter.

capability.description: Capability the adapter must declare for the case to apply, or null when it applies to every adapter.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria of the contract that the case covers, from C1 to C33.

scenario.description: Simulated child scenario the case uses, by name, or null when it uses none.

check.description: What is verified: the test file that runs it, or the observable outcome the case requires.
